title: BEFORE NOVEMBER ENDS SAY THIS POWERFUL PRAYER AND DECLARATION
text: Father, we give you glory. We honor you. We magnify your holy name. You are Yahweh, the God that never fails. You are the same yesterday, today, and forever. And tonight, as we lift our voices before the throne of grace, something will shift in the realm of the spirit. Somebody lift your voice and begin to bless him. Say, "Lord, I thank you for the gift of life. I thank you for preservation. I thank you for November. We give you praise, Jesus. The Lord is already moving. Even before we begin to pray, there's someone under the sound of my voice, the Lord is saying, I'm turning the page of delay. Yes, I hear it. Delay is over. Isaiah 43 18-19 says, "Do not remember the former things, nor consider the things of old. Behold, I will do a new thing now. It shall spring forth. Somebody shout now. >> Now. >> Before November ends, I prophesy. May the new thing God is doing appear in your life in the name of Jesus. >> Lift your hands and begin to pray in the spirit. Let your spirit ascend. Let your hunger rise. You didn't come here to spectate. You came to [singing and music] encounter fire. You came to shift seasons. The Lord is saying to someone, I am restoring the years that the locust has eaten. Joel 2:255 declares, "I will restore to you the years that the swarming locust has eaten." Before November ends, your restoration begins. Listen carefully. Every time God is about to shift a man, he gives a prophetic word that provokes faith. Faith is the bridge between your prophecy and your manifestation. Romans 10:17, faith comes by hearing and hearing by the word of God. So tonight, as this word comes forth, your faith will receive fire. There are three prophetic instructions God gave me for tonight's service. Number one, speak to the month. Number two, revoke satanic expectations. Number three, declare divine speed before the end of November. We'll handle them one after another as the spirit leads. But hear me, before the end of this month, something you've been praying for since January will appear by fire. Psalm 65:11 says, "You crown the year with your goodness and your parts drip with [music] abundance." Even if it is November 30th, God can still decorate your destiny. Do you believe that? Look at me. God is never late. He is the God that shows up when men have concluded is over. John 11:43, Lazarus come forth. That means even dead things can answer when the voice of God comes. So tonight as the word comes, dead businesses will hear it. Dead relationships will hear it. DEAD DREAMS will hear it and they will come forth. Lift your hands and pray in the spirit again. Shandalaba ephra tossia. I decree and declare before November ends, may your name be mentioned in high places. May help us locate you without delay. May every closed door opened by fire. May every stagnation be reversed. Now the Lord is saying there's someone watching online. Your name is Esther. You have been weeping concerning your rent. BEFORE THE END of this week, help is coming. There's another person. Your name is Michael. You have a contract hanging since July. I decree [music] and declare by the spirit of prophecy BEFORE NOVEMBER ENDS, THAT CONTRACT is released in your favor. Let's go deeper. Listen, God is teaching us something about time. Time is a weapon. Ephesians 5:16, redeeming the time because the days are evil. That means you can buy back lost moments. How? Through revelation and prayer. Tonight's prayer is a redemption of time. What you lost from January to October, heaven will compress it into November. Lift your hands and say, "Father, redeem my time." SAY IT AGAIN. FATHER, REDEEM MY TIME. So I decree and declare every wasted season, every delay, every missed opportunity, by the blood of the lamb, let there be restoration now. Thus say the spirit of God, November shall not end until laughter returns to your house. Someone's miracle has been in transit. Angels are dispatching it right now. I see the Lord releasing angelic couriers for he shall give his angels charge over you. Psalm 91:1 I decree let angels locate your family, your business, your destiny, your paperwork, fire of the Holy Ghost, we give you glory, Jesus, we honor you. [music] We acknowledge that without you, we can do nothing. So tonight, we surrender everything to you. Say this after me. Lord Jesus, before November ends, make me a sign and a wonder. Say it again. Lord Jesus, before November ends, make me a sign and a wonder. Isaiah 8:18. Behold, I and the children whom the Lord has given me are for signs and wonders in Israel. I decree over you, you will not end this month as you entered it. Something must shift. Something must break open. Something must multiply. The Lord is touching someone's leg condition right now. You couldn't walk properly for weeks. Power of God is on that leg now. Move it. Move it. >> Yes, it's healed completely. Glory to God. Listen, before November ends, some of you will step into realms of supernatural favor that will shock you. Genesis 39 21. But the Lord was with Joseph and showed him mercy, and he gave him favor in the sight of the keeper of the prison. Even in prison, favor located Joseph. Wherever you are, I decree favor will locate you. There are three people you have been fasting secretly, praying for direction about relocation. The Lord says stay one more month. December will bring clarity. Thus sayeth the spirit of God. I am restoring families this month. Every scattered relationship, every broken covenant of love and unity be restored. Lift your hands again. Let's engage the mystery of prophecy and prayer. Say, in the name of Jesus, November will deliver all that belongs to me. Say it again. November will deliver all that belongs to me. Shaba, I decree and declare, every financial door that has been shut, open now. Every health challenge dissolve by fire. Every demonic altar collapse. Every word spoken against your rising backfire. Now somebody shout before November ends. >> Say it again. Before November ends, you will testify. You will dance. You will shout for joy. Glory to God. The atmosphere is shifting now. [music] There's an anointing of divine acceleration. Amos 93. Behold, the day is come, sayaeth the Lord, when the plowman shall overtake the reaper. That means divine speed. I decree what should have taken years will happen in days. Someone's visa approval that has been delayed, it is released now. Someone's medical report is being reversed. Someone's marital delay is ending tonight. Glory to God. Father, we thank you. Your presence is mighty in this place. We will not live the same way we came. Let the fire keep burning. Let the word keep walking. Give him praise. Give him praise. Lift your hands everyone. Lift them high to the heavens. Father, we open the gates of the spirit. Let the fire of revival sweep across this room. Let chains break. Let veils be torn. [music] Every atmosphere of delays, SCATTER, EVERY DARK covering over families, lift. Listen carefully. When prophecy meets obedience, [music] manifestation begins. 2 Chronicles 20. Believe in the Lord your God, so shall you be established. Believe his prophets, [music] so shall you prosper. Tonight, prosperity is not a suggestion. It's an instruction. There are three levels of deliverance coming tonight. One, deliverance from wrong cycles. [music] Two, deliverance from demonic covenants. Three, deliverance from the spirit of almost there but never there. If any of these sound like you, shout fire. Thus, sayeth the spirit of God. Every pattern that made your parents struggle, it shall not repeat in your life. Every pattern of rising and falling be broken now. Psalm 124:7. Our soul has escaped as [music] a bird out of the snare of the fowlers. The snare is broken and we have escaped. I decree the snare is broken. You have escaped poverty. You have escaped sickness. You have escaped shame. Hear me. November is the month of divine completion. Whatever began in tears will end in laughter. Ecclesiastes 7:8. Better is the end of a thing than the beginning thereof. Before November ends, your story will end better than it started. >> Now lift your right hand. Say after me, in the name of Jesus, I command every negative prophecy over my life cancelled. I command every evil altar catch fire now. I command my destiny, arise and shine. Isaiah 60:1, arise, shine, for your light has come and the [music] glory of the Lord is risen upon you. I decree arise financially, [music] arise spiritually, arise maritally, arise in influence. Somebody's business is under a siege. The Lord says, "I am sending men of valor to partner with you. Receive it." Another person, your name is Sandra. Your mother has been sick for months. Right now, the healing power of God is touching her. Be healed in Jesus' name. Amen. >> Listen, the Lord said, "Break the altar of fear." Fear is a gate that invites oppression. Job 3:3, [music] for the thing I greatly feared has come upon me from tonight. No more fear of failure, no more fear of death, no more fear of shame. Say, I refuse to fear. For God has not given me the spirit of fear, but of power, love, and a sound mind. 2 Timothy 1:7. Now shout power. >> I decree and declare by the anointing of the Holy Ghost, receive strength to finish this year well. Every arrow assigned to distract you backfire. Every witchcraft agenda collapse by fire. Every monitoring SPIRIT BE BLINDED in Jesus name. There's someone you dream constantly of eating in your sleep. That affliction ends now. The fire of God consumes every satanic covenant enter through dreams. Lift your two hands. Pray violently in tongues for the next 60 seconds. My father, every yoke of witchcraft manipulation, let it be broken. Every altar in ancestral foundations, let it CATCH FIRE. EVERY TOKEN of blood covenant being nullified by the blood of Jesus. Somebody's destiny is coming out of the cage right now. I hear the chains of limitation snapping. There's a woman named patience. The Lord says your waiting season is over. You are stepping into manifestation before November ends. >> Lift your voice and begin to declare, "My time has come. My season has shifted. My gates are open." Psalm 24:7. Lift up your heads, oh ye gates, and be lifted up, ye everlasting doors, and the King of glory shall come in. I decree every gate of opportunity, lift up your head. Every financial gate, lift up your head. Every marital gate, LIFT UP YOUR HEAD. NOW HEAR THIS PROPHETIC WORD. Before November ends, the voice of joy will not depart from your house. Jeremiah 33:1. The voice of joy and the voice of gladness, for the Lord is good. His mercy endures forever. So shall it be. >> [music] >> The Lord is healing hearts right now. Emotional wounds, betrayal, rejection, healed [music] by fire. Receive new strength. Receive new hope. Receive new vision. Worship moment. You are Yahweh. E. We give you glory, Jesus. We honor you, mighty God. You have done what money cannot buy. You have lifted burdens men could not lift. Now lift your right hand. Make this declaration seven times. Before November ends, [music] I will testify. Now begin to list your expectations. Speak to November. SAY, NOVEMBER, HEAR the word of the Lord. You will not SWALLOW MY MIRACLE. YOU WILL FORM MY TESTIMONY. I DECREE AND DECLARE the angels of the last HOUR ARE RELEASED. LET THEM bring overdue blessings. LET THEM OVERTURN VERDICTS. LET THEM SPEED UP PROMOTIONS. LET THEM restore what was lost. Someone under the sound of my voice. You have a court case scheduled this month. The Lord says, "Fear not, for I will fight for you and you shall hold your peace." Exodus 14:14. Victory is yours. Another person, you applied for a scholarship. I hear the Lord say the approval letter is coming before the 30th of November. Receive it now. Oh, thank you, Holy Spirit. Lactosakados, the presence of God is heavy in this place. Now I speak over everyone from the crown of your head to the soles of your feet. Be enveloped by the glory of God. Let the seal of divine preservation rest upon you. Psalm 91:10. No evil shall befall you, nor shall any plague come near your dwelling. Your family is preserved. Your business is preserved. Your destiny is preserved. You will not die before your time. Every arrow of premature DEATH RETURN TO SEND. EVERY COFFIN PREPARED, CATCH FIRE. EVERY GRAVE DUG BE SEALED BY THE BLOOD OF JESUS. Like I decree the month of November becomes your month of laughter, your month of evidence, your month of manifestation. You shall end the year rejoicing. >> Lift your hands. Everyone say, "Father, I believe that before November ends, [music] you will restore my wasted years." Joel 2:25. So I will restore to you the years that the swarming locust has eaten. That's not a promise from a man. That's the voice of the eternal one. It means time can be restored, resources can be restored, honor can be restored, dignity can be restored. Listen carefully. Restoration is not God giving you what you lost. Restoration is God giving you what you lost plus what you would have gained if you never lost it. I decree before November ends, may that restoration become your reality. Everything you should have stepped into by March, by June, by September, I compress it into November in Jesus' name. Now stretch your hands toward the altar. Father, breathe on these hands. Let them become hands of wealth. Let them become hands of multiplication. Let them become hands that will no longer beg. Deuteronomy [music] 8:18. For it is he who gives you power to get wealth. Power to get wealth is a spiritual force. That means poverty is not first economic is spiritual. And tonight the anointing to break that yoke rest on you now. Every family pattern of financial hardship break now. Every ancient covenant of emptiness SCATTER BY FIRE. EVERY BLOODLINE limitation be uprooted in Jesus' name. Fire. Hallelujah. [music] There's someone under the sound of my voice. You've been losing money mysteriously. [music] The Lord says that leakage is closed now. No more financial drain. No more empty pockets. Receive divine wisdom for multiplication. Hear me. God is not against wealth. He is against covetousness. The Bible says in 3 John verse 2, "Beloved, I wish above all things that you prosper and be in health even as your soul prospers." Prosperity that flows from the soul cannot destroy you. It becomes a platform for kingdom advancement. I decree may God trust you with resources. May he give you money that nations will hear about. May he place you among financial apostles of the end time. Thus said the spirit of God before November ends. I will raise helpers who will locate you without explanation. People you do not know will fight battles you never knew existed. Someone will mention your name for good where it matters most. Psalm 44:3. They did not gain possession of the land by their own sword, nor did their own arm save them, but it was your right hand, your arm, and the light of your countenance. That means favor is better than labor. Favor shortens the distance between prophecy and manifestation. Say this loud. Lord, let favor rest upon me. >> Say it again. Let favor rest upon me. I decree before November ends, favor at your workplace, favor in your business, [music] favor in your applications, favor in your relationships, favor in your family. Let the mantle of unusual favor rest on you. Now listen, there is an anointing called the anointing for divine remembrance. Genesis 41:E14. Then Pharaoh sent and called Joseph and they brought him hastily out of the dungeon. That means God can cause men to remember you suddenly. I decree before November ends, someone important will remember you for good. That phone call will come. That email will come. That letter will come. Somebody's file that has been buried under piles of others. I see an angel pulling it out. You will receive news that makes you cry tears of joy. [applause] Hallelujah. Now hear this. God says, "I am bringing back your lost opportunities." Someone here lost a business contract because of misunderstanding. Another lost a position by betrayal. Thus sayeth the spirit, I am restoring it multiplied. Lift your voice and say restoration. Seven times. Restoration. Restoration. I decree [music] and declare every stolen opportunity, every stolen relationship, every stolen position BE RESTORED. EVERY CLOSED GATE OPEN, EVERY PADLOCK BREAK, EVERY DELAY DISSOLVE. >> Psalm 126 verse 1-2. When the Lord turned again the captivity of Zion, we were like those who dream. I decree before November ends, your testimony will look like a dream. You look at your life and wonder, is this me now? Family altars that fight progress catch fire. Household covenants of LACK BURN TO ASHES. Satanic embaros on promotion lifted by fire. The Lord says there's a woman named Grace. Your shop has been stagnant for months. Before November ends, three major customers will locate you. And there's a young man, Emmanuel. You've been praying for a job. You will receive a call before the 27th of this month. Now say, "Lord, I enter into overflow." Psalm 23:5, "My cup runs over." Overflow means more than enough, more than explanation, more than calculation. I decree step into overflow. Finances overflow, joy overflow, peace overflow, health overflow. Now hear this prophetic instruction. Write today's date down because within the next 7 days someone will experience a turnaround that defies logic. You will say truly the Lord has visited me. Let's lift our hands and thank him. Father, thank you for breaking the siege of lack, for releasing favor, for restoring time. We give you all the glory. Say, "Before November ends, I will see the goodness of the Lord in the land of the living." Psalm 27:13. Glory to God. Hallelujah. Give him praise. Dance before him. Celebrate your victory. We give you all the glory.
